reasons: The succinct completely randomized-design algorithm must measure an input that does not contain the exponentially large assignment list counted by the existing explicit-support length.

verdict.note: Accepted both additions: ell_CRE correctly measures the succinct CRE input without charging for an exponential support list, and the generating-function DP exactly counts labeled fixed-size assignments with doubled ordinary midranks, handles equality faces and arbitrary fixed treatment-indexed missingness, and has polynomial per-leaf bit complexity. The resulting fixed-k CRE claim is algorithmic only and introduces no unsupported hardness or Li--Sheng--Yu transfer claim.
